players.product: Carbonate fuel-cell power plants (FuelCell Energy Blocks) for behind-the-meter baseload data-center power

quarterly_data.signal: FuelCell Energy's Q3 FY2026 release (8-K), backlog as of July 31, 2026: Committed Backlog - product $108,865 thousand, service $263,648 thousand, generation $915,725 thousand, Advanced Technologies $7,772 thousand, total $1,296,010 thousand (from $1,244,854 thousand); Awarded Capacity Backlog (Phases 1, 2 and 3 of the Fit Energy CEPA) - product $1,058,750 thousand and service $1,291,500 thousand, total $2,350,250 thousand; total Committed and Awarded Capacity Backlog $3,646,260 thousand. Awarded Capacity Backlog is not contracted or firm order backlog.
quarterly_data.figure: Committed $1,296,010 thousand; Awarded Capacity product $1,058,750 thousand + service $1,291,500 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: The 75 MW Capacity Reservation Agreement signed after Q3 with a major data center operator for a planned Texas project is expected to consist of six 12.5 MW FuelCell Energy Block systems; the upfront reservation payment gives the operator priority access to FuelCell's manufacturing capacity while the parties finalize definitive project agreements, and FuelCell will reserve manufacturing capacity and initiate procurement of long-lead components. Financial terms were not disclosed.
quarterly_data.figure: 75 MW = six 12.5 MW FuelCell Energy Block systems

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 deck: 4.4 GW of proposals delivered in Q3 2026, bringing the FY2026 total to ~10 GW; a >6x increase in total pipeline and a 3x increase in average proposal size from Q1 to Q3 2026; pipeline customers include hyperscalers, data center developers, colocation providers and neocloud providers. The first FuelCell Energy Block can ship 90 days after signing, enabling full on-site power commissioning in under 1 year; company-estimated cost of energy ~$0.09/kWh (20-year project term, 8.0% WACC, 30% ITC, fuel at $4.50/MMBtu, excluding interconnect, permitting and taxes). A 1 GW+ plant (1 GW+ annualized cell capacity target) is in the planning stage, with U.S.-based site selection in progress.
quarterly_data.figure: 4.4 GW of Q3 proposals; first block ships 90 days after signing; ~$0.09/kWh estimated cost

quarterly_data.signal: Korea repowering: all 42 fuel cell modules committed to GGE since 2024 have been delivered (6 in Q3 FY2026). The deck table shows CGN-Yulchon deliveries of 2 modules in Q1 and 6 estimated in Q4 FY2026, and Korea repowering revenue of $12M in Q1, $18M in Q2, $18M in Q3 and an $18M estimate for Q4 FY2026. Module replacements under LTSAs total 56.3 MW / 45 modules, limited before 2028, with 34 Korea restacks projected between mid-2028 and Q4 2030. The Groton Project upgrade to three 2.5 MW FCE blocks is expected to be completed in fiscal 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: Q4 FY2026 Korea estimate: 6 CGN modules, $18M; 34 Korea restacks mid-2028 to Q4 2030
